hero.subtitle: Discover the new avant-garde collection where bold modern silhouettes meet timeless Indian craftsmanship.

about.title: The
about.description: Founded on the principles of unapologetic elegance and rich Indian heritage, our atelier has spent over a decade redefining modern luxury. We believe in the power of silhouette, the necessity of impeccable handwoven craftsmanship, and the bold statement of stark contrast.

timeline.title: Atelier Foundation
timeline.description: The brand was born in a small studio in Mumbai, focusing entirely on bespoke tailoring and contemporary Indian silhouettes.

timeline.title: First Runway
timeline.description: Debuted the first full collection at Lakme Fashion Week, gaining international recognition for the stark black & crimson palette.

timeline.title: Global Expansion
timeline.description: Opened flagship stores in Delhi, New York, and Dubai. Expanding into luxury accessories and bridal wear.

testimonials.quote: Sutra's pieces are a masterclass in structural elegance. The FW27 collection single-handedly redefined how we style regal looks for modern weddings and the red carpet.
testimonials.name: Nandita Verma

testimonials.quote: Working with this atelier is a revelation. The uncompromising quality and dramatic silhouettes always make my clients the center of attention.
testimonials.name: Rohan Kapoor

testimonials.quote: Our boutique clients demand the extraordinary. The capsule collections from Sutra consistently exceed expectations with their striking color palette and intricate embroidery.
testimonials.name: Meera Rajput
